text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And claiming victory in this clash of the 
Big Three is... Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
A-Awesome! That three-way showdown was so 
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I came today! I feel like I 
just saw something incredible...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I did it…… I won……!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Chan-chan!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh, dammit, shit...! I really don't 
wanna say that, but still.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You really are strong. So cool.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really glad I got to run with you. It 
gave me such an incredible thrill."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Still! Next time, I won't lose! Next 
time, I'm gonna run the coolest race out 
of everyone!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So, see ya later, Chan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...'Again'?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Chan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Agh, jeez! I didn't run just to say 
something like this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating, but today was a 
complete defeat. It was your day."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, congratulations. Please let me say 
that much.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I won't lose next time! So wash 
your neck and get ready!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...'Next time.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Aston Machan watched the two walk away, 
thunderous applause enveloped her. As if 
drawn by it, she looked up toward the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Mar-chan! You were the best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd get to see a Big Three 
showdown again! I'm looking forward to 
your future races too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Pleasant sounds, lovely scenery.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Any place where I stand alongside those 
two always becomes so vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And then, 'again' and 'next.'

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is blessed with friends... and 
with rivals."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Vodka, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Next time. Let's definitely race again.
